description: This file declares external function prototypes for the Dslh Helper Container Object, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions within the DSL Home Model implementation.

methods.name: DslhCreateHelperContainer
methods.description: Creates a new Helper Container Object with specified context handles.

methods.name: DslhHcoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Helper Container Object.

methods.name: DslhHcoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the Helper Container Object instance.

methods.name: DslhHcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects within the Helper Container Object.

methods.name: DslhHcoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Helper Container Object to a ready state.
